title: Idempotents of B/IB lift after an etale neighbourhood of V(I)
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal, $A\to B$ a ring map with $B$ integral over $A$, and $\bar e\in B/IB$ an idempotent. Then there exist a ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the induced map $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ is an isomorphism, and an idempotent $e'\in B\otimes_AA'$ lifting $\bar e$: the composite $B\otimes_AA'\to B\otimes_A(A'/IA')\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}_B\otimes\alpha^{-1}}B\otimes_A(A/I)=B/IB$ maps $e'$ to $\bar e$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07M4 (lemma-lift-idempotent-upstairs) and its proof (uses Lemma lemma-helper-integral, Lemma lemma-lift-factorization-easy, Lemma lemma-separate-image-closed-from-closed, Algebra Lemmas Tag 00GU, 00HZ and lemma-disjoint-decomposition); the precise meaning of 'lifting' (via the isomorphism $A/I\cong A'/IA'$) is made explicit by the agent
